text:
maria: Quick heads-up — CI caught a 6-10% tail-latency regression in nightly matmul-quant build on p4s, looks thermal-related. :eyes:
kevin: ugh. which bench? perf/regressions show 95th or 99th?
maria: 99th on small-batch (seq128, batch1) inference microbench. attached logs in CI artifact.
deploy-bot: preflight check finished for build runtime-v2.14.7-quant. status: unstable. failing tests: perf-telemetry, smoke-eviction.
nana: ana here — looks like KV cache thrash when GPUs enter thermal throttle mode, eviction rate spikes in the logs. can we reproduce local?
kevin: reproducer script runs fine on my local gpus with old kernel, fails when I switch to new matmul kernel variant. likely kernel register scheduling change.
tom: QA: can reproduce in staging with 10-min sustained load, 1% of workers hit 2x latency. created issue RN-471.
maria: proposed plan: 1) freeze rollout, 2) pin region-night to runtime-v2.14.6, 3) prepare hotpatch with fallback shim to older vectorized matmul, 4) run targeted canary (5% in us-west) with extended 30m smoke. agree?
kevin: agree. I can prepare hotpatch branch that toggles kernel via env flag: RUNTIME_MATMUL_VARIANT=legacy. will add fast-path selector so we can flip without full deployment.
dan: ops question — pin how, deploybot or API? we need TTL on pin.
maria: use deploybot pin: `deploybot pin --service runtime --version v2.14.6 --scope region:us-west --ttl 12h`
kevin: note: the env flag only affects the kernel selection codepath; it won't change ABI. KV cache formats unchanged. should be safe for rollback.
nana: for canary, let's use these gates: 1) 5xx < 0.1%, 2) 99p latency < baseline + 15%, 3) eviction-rate <= 1.2x baseline. If any gate fails, auto-pin back and notify oncall.
tom: QA will run synthetic prompt set and perf harness during the 30m window. I'll post results.
maria: release notes checklist for ops: add a line under "Runtime" -> "matmul kernel variant introduced; rolled back to legacy for night bucket due to thermal tail regressions; hotpatch pending." Also include rollback instructions (see below).
kevin: adding quick rollback snippet for ops channel: ```bash
# roll back region to v2.14.6
deploybot pin --service runtime --version v2.14.6 --scope region:us-west --reason "thermal regression"
# remove pin when safe
deploybot unpin --service runtime --scope region:us-west
```
maria: timeline: pin in 10m, build hotpatch in next 40m, smoke canary at +1h, then decide rollforward at +2h. if hotpatch not ready, extend pin to 24h and open incident if user-facing errors observed.
nana: I'm oncall — I'll monitor the canary dashboards and set alerts for the three gates. create a short Ops playbook snippet in the incident.
dan: I'll add a short annotation to deploybot so that pinned nodes surface in the SRE dashboards: `deploybot annotate --key=pin-reason --value=thermal-regress`
tom: QA note: will also check model-quality smoke on small prompt suite to ensure no numeric drift from the legacy kernel.
kevin: after hotpatch deploy, we'll enable feature-flagged telemetry to capture per-op latency histogram. helpful for deciding rollforward.
maria: OK everyone — action items assigned. I'll post a concise status update in 30m. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: pin task enqueued: runtime pinned to v2.14.6 in us-west (ttl 12h) — executor: deploy-bot-ops-3
kevin: thanks. tagging @product (dan) — will follow up if customer-impact visible.
dan: thanks — I'll prep comms if external facing services degrade.
maria: update: QA smoke at +30m clear so far. creating PR for hotpatch branch with selector and test. will link when ready. :white_check_mark:
